# §7 Peer Benchmarking — Highlight Candidates

1. **Platform order activity in the bottom 25% of peers** — 66 all-time orders vs. a peer median of 245 (73% below median, below p25 of 103) among 52 comparable accounts on the same platform bundle; order volume is the widest gap in the peer comparison. [→ #peer]
2. **Login activity is near the peer median — the team is present** — 2,411 total logins vs. a peer median of 2,578 (6.5% below), placing Buster & Punch between p25 and the median; the engagement base is competitive and doesn't require a ramp-up to close other gaps. [→ #peer]
3. **Product search trails the bottom quartile** — 2,244 searches vs. a peer median of 5,017 and p25 of 3,455; low discovery activity correlates directly with the order volume gap and suggests an underused selling workflow. [→ #peer]
4. **Sales Portal and Portal Orders active — ahead of half the peer group** — both features are live vs. 50% peer adoption; Buster & Punch is getting value from capabilities that half of comparable accounts have not yet activated. [→ #peer]
5. **Top performers submit 50–120× more orders on comparable login volumes** — the #1 peer submits 8,067 orders with 3,414 logins; even the #10 peer submits 334 orders. The gap is not in access or presence — it's in conversion of sessions to orders. [→ #peer]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **HIGH**: Close the order-volume gap by driving product search and order submission within existing login sessions — the 2,411 logins already match the peer median range, so the opportunity is making each session more productive rather than increasing login frequency. [→ #peer]
